$n=6$: $D_6 = (6-1)(D_5 + D_4) = 5(44 + 9) = 5(53) = 265$

Verification using approximation $D_n \approx \frac{n!}{e}$:
$6! = 720$
$e \approx 2.718$
$720 / 2.718 \approx 265$
